g.text: AI Execution Environment (aee) — Architecture & Execution Engine
Control Plane Orchestration, Bounded Runtime Container Pool, Storage Isolation & LSM-Tree Context Memory
• Claude Code: Headless ticket subagents & hooks
• runtime | slots | worktrees: Pool & checkout mgmt
• context | setup | doctor | validate: Engine control
• PR Creator / Maintainer: Automated review & CI
Fetch-only sync (`ensure.sh`). Never altered by agents; shared `.git` objects source.
Survives worktree and container disposal. Stores `meta.json`, `session-state.md`, `artifacts/`.
Branched explicitly from `origin/<default>`. Uses relative Git administrative link.
Per-project GitHub/Git credentials. Never baked into container images or checked into Git.
